name: Star River Microkernel
description: Embeddable AI-assistant kernel in Go+C: context assembly, memory, emotion, tools/MCP, multimodal, encrypted local storage. BYOK, zero backend.
sites_https_justification: All project URLs use https (GitHub, pkg.go.dev).
description_good_justification: README opens by stating what it is: an embeddable AI-assistant kernel (Go+C) providing context assembly, memory, emotion, tools/MCP, encrypted storage; BYOK, no backend. See https://github.com/cjintao133-cell/star-river/blob/main/README.md and https://github.com/cjintao133-cell/star-river/blob/main/docs/product-brief.md.
interact_justification: Build/run: `go run ./examples/hello-kernel` (offline demo) and docs/usage.md. Feedback: GitHub Issues and Discussions.
contribution_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md documents the per-commit gate, DCO sign-off, and red lines: https://github.com/cjintao133-cell/star-river/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md.
contribution_requirements_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md lists the required checks a change must pass (gofmt, go vet, staticcheck, go test, layering guard) and the process: https://github.com/cjintao133-cell/star-river/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
floss_license_justification: Apache-2.0 is an OSI-approved FLOSS license.
documentation_basics_justification: docs/ covers product, features, usage, FAQ, troubleshooting, architecture: https://github.com/cjintao133-cell/star-river/blob/main/docs/README.md.
documentation_interface_justification: README + docs/usage.md show how to invoke the CLI and embed the kernel (Go API): https://github.com/cjintao133-cell/star-river/blob/main/docs/usage.md.
repo_track_justification: Git records every change with author and date.
repo_interim_justification: Work is committed to main continuously, not only at release time.
version_unique_justification: Releases use unique semantic versions; e.g. git tag v0.1.0 and the GitHub Release.
release_notes_justification: RELEASE.md plus per-version GitHub Releases describe each release: https://github.com/cjintao133-cell/star-river/blob/main/RELEASE.md.
release_notes_vulns_justification: No release has yet fixed a publicly known vulnerability with a CVE.
report_process_justification: Bugs and requests are filed via GitHub Issues (templates configured): https://github.com/cjintao133-cell/star-river/issues
report_responses_justification: The maintainer responds to bug reports on the issue tracker on a best-effort basis (solo project).
enhancement_responses_justification: Enhancement requests get a response on the issue tracker on a best-effort basis.
report_archive_justification: Issues and their discussion remain public and searchable: https://github.com/cjintao133-cell/star-river/issues?q=is%3Aissue.
vulnerability_report_process_justificati: SECURITY.md documents the vulnerability reporting process and coordinated disclosure: https://github.com/cjintao133-cell/star-river/blob/main/SECURITY.md.
vulnerability_report_private_justificati: Private reporting via GitHub Security Advisories: https://github.com/cjintao133-cell/star-river/security/advisories/new , or by email as stated in SECURITY.md (https://github.com/cjintao133-cell/star-river/blob/main/SECURITY.md).
vulnerability_report_response_justificat: SECURITY.md commits to acknowledging a report within 7 days.
build_justification: `go build ./...` works (verified in CI); native C parts build via native/Makefile. CI builds on every push.
build_common_tools_justification: Standard Go toolchain (go build/test) plus make for the C hot paths.
build_floss_tools_justification: Go toolchain and make/gcc are all FLOSS.
test_justification: Automated Go test suite (131 test files, ~16k lines): `go test ./...`; race detector in CI.
test_invocation_justification: Run `go test ./...` (and `go test -race ./...` for concurrent packages); documented in CONTRIBUTING.md and README.
test_most_justification: Statement coverage is not currently measured, so 'most of the code is covered' is not asserted. The suite is substantial but this is stated honestly.
test_policy_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md defines when tests are required and the per-commit gate: https://github.com/cjintao133-cell/star-river/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md.
tests_are_added_justification: New functionality and bug fixes are expected to ship with tests, per CONTRIBUTING.md.
tests_documented_added_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md documents the requirement to add tests with changes.
warnings_justification: Compiler warnings addressed; build is clean with `go vet`.
warnings_fixed_justification: `go vet` and `staticcheck` pass in CI; warnings are fixed before merge.
warnings_strict_justification: `go vet` (strict) and `staticcheck` run in CI and must pass.
know_secure_design_justification: At least one maintainer understands secure design; documented red lines and threat boundary in docs/architecture.md and docs/privacy-boundary.md.
know_common_errors_justification: docs/architecture.md and docs/secret-storage.md discuss common security pitfalls (key handling, log scrubbing, redirect-disable).
crypto_published_justification: Cryptography uses only standard, published algorithms (AES-256-GCM, ed25519) via the Go standard library; see kernel/store/crypto.go.
crypto_call_justification: Calls standard trusted crypto libraries (Go crypto/aes, crypto/cipher, crypto/rand) rather than re-implementing primitives.
crypto_floss_justification: All cryptography is FLOSS (Go standard library).
crypto_keylength_justification: AES-256 uses 32-byte keys; nonces are 12 bytes; ed25519 uses its standard key size. See kernel/store/crypto.go.
crypto_working_justification: Encrypt/decrypt round-trip is covered by tests (kernel/store/crypto_test.go); incorrect key/tampered AAD is rejected.
crypto_pfs_justification: The project implements no custom network transport cryptography; TLS (with forward secrecy defaults) is provided by Go net/http for outbound calls.
crypto_password_storage_justification: No user passwords are stored; master keys live in Android Keystore / Windows DPAPI, not in a password database.
crypto_random_justification: Uses crypto/rand for key and nonce generation (not a non-cryptographic PRNG).
delivery_unsigned_justification: Delivery is over HTTPS over authenticated channels; no unauthenticated channels used.
vulnerabilities_fixed_60_days_justificat: No known unfixed vulnerabilities; govulncheck is clean in CI, and SECURITY.md commits to prompt fixes.
vulnerabilities_critical_fixed_justifica: No known critical vulnerabilities; govulncheck + CodeQL run in CI.
static_analysis_justification: staticcheck, go vet, and CodeQL run in CI.
static_analysis_common_vulnerabilities_j: CodeQL (security queries) plus govulncheck for dependency vulnerabilities run in CI.
static_analysis_fixed_justification: Static-analysis findings are fixed before merge; CI fails on new issues.
static_analysis_often_justification: Static analysis runs automatically on every push and pull request in CI.
dynamic_analysis_unsafe_justification: Core is memory-safe Go; the small C hot paths are isolated. No unsafe memory handling is user-exposed yet.
dynamic_analysis_enable_assertions_justi: Go runtime checks and the test suite enable runtime assertions during testing.
dynamic_analysis_fixed_justification: No dynamic-analysis tooling (e.g. fuzzing) is in place yet, so there are no such findings to fix.
crypto_weaknesses_justification: Only strong primitives are used (AES-256-GCM, ed25519); no weak/broken algorithms (no MD5/SHA1/DES/RC4).
test_continuous_integration_justificatio: CI (.github/workflows/ci.yml) builds, vets, runs the test suite and -race on every push.
discussion_justification: GitHub Issues and Discussions are enabled for questions and discussion.
no_leaked_credentials_justification: No secrets are committed; keys are read only from files/env/Keystore at runtime, never hardcoded.
english_justification: Primary documentation is in English (README.md and docs/*.md).
maintained_justification: Actively maintained: recent commits, CI runs on every push, releases tagged (v0.1.0).
dco_justification: Contributions are signed off per the DCO (git commit -s). See https://github.com/cjintao133-cell/star-river/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
governance_justification: Decision model, roles and process documented. See https://github.com/cjintao133-cell/star-river/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md
access_continuity_justification: Public reproducible source + lockbox custody continuity plan. See https://github.com/cjintao133-cell/star-river/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md
bus_factor_justification: Single maintainer; mitigation documented (public reproducible source + lockbox). See https://github.com/cjintao133-cell/star-river/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md
documentation_current_justification: Docs in sync with current version. See https://github.com/cjintao133-cell/star-river/blob/main/docs/README.md
accessibility_best_practices_justificati: Docs are plain Markdown, screen-reader friendly. See https://github.com/cjintao133-cell/star-river/blob/main/README.md
sites_password_security_justification: Project sites store no user passwords.
vulnerability_report_credit_justificatio: No vulnerabilities resolved in the last 12 months.
coding_standards_justification: Explicit coding standards for Go and C. See https://github.com/cjintao133-cell/star-river/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
installation_development_quick_justifica: Documented dev bootstrap + per-commit gate. See https://github.com/cjintao133-cell/star-river/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
interfaces_current_justification: CI staticcheck flags deprecated APIs. See https://github.com/cjintao133-cell/star-river/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml
automated_integration_testing_justificat: go test on every push/PR. See https://github.com/cjintao133-cell/star-river/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml
regression_tests_added50_justification: No bugs fixed in last six months; policy requires regression tests. See https://github.com/cjintao133-cell/star-river/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
test_policy_mandated_justification: Written policy: tests for new functionality. See https://github.com/cjintao133-cell/star-river/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
crypto_credential_agility_justification: Keys via OS keystore, rotatable. See https://github.com/cjintao133-cell/star-river/blob/main/docs/security-requirements.md
crypto_certificate_verification_justific: Cert verification on by default. See https://github.com/cjintao133-cell/star-river/blob/main/docs/security-requirements.md
